OBSERVATION: USER_STOP is required to be immediate and preemptive, but the normal pre-mutation revalidation list does not bind MISSION_FENCE_STATE.STATE_VERSION, MISSION_STATUS, EXECUTION_PHASE, STOPPING/STOPPED state, WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, or MUTATION_GATE. The USER_STOP clauses do not explicitly require STOP entry to increment ENGINEERING_EPOCH or MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH. Therefore a lease can remain valid across a STOP CAS unless an implementation adds an unstated extra fence.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An ACTIVE member holds a valid lease bound to mission generation, membership epoch/generation, task version, spec hash, resource graph hash, engineering epoch, and lease generation.
The worker performs the [220] canonical-state read and listed REVALIDATE checks while USER_STOP is not yet present and all lease bindings match.
Immediately after that revalidation and before IMPLEMENT ON WORKER BRANCH, USER_STOP is committed through the Mission Fence as required by [166].

If STOP changes only Mission Fence stop/transition state and gates, the lease bindings listed in [121] remain unchanged; [220] does not require a final atomic check of stop state or MUTATION_GATE at the product write.

The worker can therefore perform a product mutation after USER_STOP without violating any explicitly listed lease-binding revalidation, contradicting [164] immediate/preemptive STOP semantics and [230] mission termination on USER_STOP.
SAFETY_IMPACT: A compliant implementation can admit a post-STOP product write through a time-of-check/time-of-use window. USER_STOP cannot be proven immediate/preemptive under the current normative bindings, so activation safety must fail closed unless this is repaired or authoritatively disproved.
REQUIRED_RESOLUTION_OPTIONS: Define STOP entry CAS to atomically close work/mutation/integration gates and increment ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH before STOP is considered effective.
Add a monotonic STOP_GENERATION or fence STATE_VERSION/gate binding to every mutation lease and require it in the final pre-write validator.
Require an atomic final mutation-admission check immediately at product write that rejects STOPPING/STOPPED or MUTATION_GATE != OPEN.
Specify crash/race semantics proving no write may commit after the authoritative STOP linearization point.
